config.title: CSS Modules

intro.title: CSS Modules
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple React component that uses CSS Modules to style a button with a unique background color and padding. The editor includes **App.jsx** and **App.module.css** so the module file is always visible next to your component. You will learn how CSS Modules work by scoping CSS class names locally to a component, preventing style conflicts across your application. The main technologies involved are React components, JSX for structure, and CSS Modules (with .module.css files) for styling. By the end, you'll understand how to import and apply scoped styles to create maintainable, conflict-free UI elements in React.
intro.usecase: CSS Modules are essential in large-scale React applications where component isolation prevents style conflicts. You'll see this pattern in enterprise dashboards with multiple independent widgets, e-commerce product grids with distinct card components, and complex form builders with reusable input fields. Developers use CSS Modules to maintain clean, scoped styles when building design systems, admin panels with modular sections, or any UI with many reusable components that need consistent but isolated styling.

objectives: Implement CSS Modules by creating and importing a dedicated stylesheet for a React component
Apply scoped CSS classes to JSX elements using the imported styles object
Construct a component with multiple styled elements using CSS Modules for encapsulation
Configure a React project to support CSS Modules by verifying the build system setup
Update existing inline styles or global CSS to use CSS Modules for better maintainability
Manipulate dynamic styling by conditionally applying CSS Modules classes based on component state or props
Integrate CSS Modules with component composition by passing class names as props to child components

steps.title: Import React and CSS Modules
steps.instruction: In **App.jsx**, add `import React from 'react'` and `import styles from './App.module.css'`. The **App.module.css** tab is the stylesheet for this lesson (same folder as App.jsx in the editor).
steps.hint: Two import lines at the top of App.jsx. Open the App.module.css tab to see the classes you will use with `styles.*` in JSX.

steps.title: Apply CSS module class to element
steps.instruction: In your component's JSX, add a className attribute to the <div> element and set it to styles.container to apply the CSS module class.
steps.hint: Use the imported styles object to access the CSS class name. The syntax is className={styles.container}.
